evals.prompt: 6 người bạn đi Tam Đảo thứ 7-CN tuần sau, budget 2 triệu/người, muốn villa có bể bơi gần Hà Nội. Lên kế hoạch và xuất file Excel.
evals.expected_output: Confirms inputs, compares ≥5 stays, waits for user pick (or documents pick in eval run), exports 4-sheet workbook via native runtime tool (Sheets or xlsx) with VND costs and Tam Đảo itinerary.
expectations: Weather or season information is included for Tam Đảo
At least five accommodation options with price, rating, and booking link
Workbook exists with sheets named Tổng quan, Lịch trình, Dự toán chi phí, Checklist
Cost estimate includes transport and a contingency buffer
Export uses native platform spreadsheet tool, not a bundled Python script

evals.prompt: Mình và người yêu chưa biết đi đâu, 3 ngày 2 đêm, khoảng 5 triệu/người, thích onsen hoặc tắm khoáng. Gợi ý và lập kế hoạch chi tiết.
evals.expected_output: Suggests 3–5 destination fits, user narrows choice, compares stays, builds couple-focused itinerary and native-export workbook.
expectations: Offers multiple destination ideas before locking one
Compares stays with pros/cons suited to couples
Itinerary is not over-packed for a 2-night trip
Budget per person is tracked against the 5M target
Workbook generated with all four required sheets via native export

evals.prompt: Gia đình 2 người lớn + 1 bé 4 tuổi đi Đà Lạt 2 đêm, 3.5 triệu/người, cần chỗ free cancellation. Plan trip giúp mình.
evals.expected_output: Family-aware lodging search, free-cancellation called out, gentle itinerary, workbook with checklist including child items.
expectations: Lodging options mention cancellation policy or free cancellation
Itinerary accounts for a young child (pace, activities)
Checklist sheet includes family-relevant packing or prep items
Does not skip weather check for Đà Lạt dates
Does not create final workbook before a stay is selected
